item.title: Apple's MacBook Neo makes repairs easier and cheaper than other MacBooks
item.description:
📝 That’s our takeaway after spending some time thumbing through the official MacBook Neo repair documentation that Apple published on its support site this week. For the 14-inch MacBook Pro, Apple will only sell you a top case replacement along with a battery, which costs a whopping $440 after you send the old component back to the company. Users could take their MacBook into an Apple Store for a keyboard fix and have to replace a part that costs one-third as much as a new laptop.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/03/more-modular-design-makes-macbook-neo-easier-to-fix-than-other-apple-laptops/
